name: Betafied - Beta 1.7.3
description: BETAFIED: MINECRAFT BETA 1.7.3 FOR BEDROCK  Betafied brings Minecraft Java Beta 1.7.3 gameplay to Bedrock Edition.  Connect from any Bedrock platform (Windows, iOS, Android, or consoles). You do not need to install any files before joining. The server sends the custom texture and behavior packs to your client automatically when you connect.  The server pairs original 2011 survival mechanics with grief prevention and multiplayer commands.  BETA 1.7.3 MECHANICS   • Classic Health: No hunger bar. Eating food restores hearts immediately.   • Original Movement: No sprinting. Pacing relies on regular walking and minecart tracks.   • Beta World Generation: Classic biome layouts, gravel beaches, alpha grass palettes, and retro lighting.   • Combat: Fast weapon hits, punch bows, and high mob damage at night.   • Audio & Visuals: Original Beta sound effects, classic void fog, and legacy blocks.  SURVIVAL MULTIPLAYER SYSTEMS   • Land Claims: Claim territory using a chest and fuel to protect your builds.   • Locks: Lock chests, furnaces, and doors to prevent theft.   • Player Shops: Create chest and sign shops to trade items with other players.   • Homes & Teleporting: Save your base with /sethome and send teleport requests with /tpa.   • Clans: Form groups, share base access, and talk in private clan chat.   • Uptime: Persistent survival world hosted 24/7.  HOW TO JOIN  Open Minecraft Bedrock.  Go to Play > Servers > Add Server.  Enter Betafied for the name and play.betafied.net for the address.  Leave the port as 19132.  Select Save, then Join. Accept the pack download on your first join to load in.  OR  add "Betafied Server" as a friend on Xbox and join!

name: Dincraft - Siden 2014
description: This is a Norwegian Minecraft server where we mostly speak Norwegian. We do welcome our international friends but keep that in mind.  Dincraft – Serveren som nekter å dø!  Dincraft sine funksjoner:  Et ranking system, basert på serien Vikings der du går fra å være en simpel Kriger, til en stor Legende. Ranking systemet gir deg masse fordeler etter hvert, så du har alltid noe å se frem til. Beste av alt, Ranken din vil aldri forsvinne.  Hard server, tilrettelagt for bygging. På serveren er det PVP i Wild, men du kan claime områdene dine og stenge folk ute. Da har folk mer frihet. Om du vil PVPe eller om du vil Bygge i ditt område.  WIKI, Innpå vår Discord så vil du finne masse Wiki innlegg som forklarer deg masse av funksjonene serveren har. Plugins, Dincraft har masse stilige plugins som utvider spillet. Alt fra teleport blokker til broer som kan stenge og åpne seg.  Bedrock Støtte, På serveren kan du spille med Bedrock Edition! Da kan til og med spille på serveren med mobilen i bussen.  Fly, På serveren så kan du fly med kommandoen /val | Da får du mulighet til å fly med flyspeed 0.4 – Da blir det mye lettere å lage kule bygg, og utforske områder. Men pass på! Om du angriper mobs/spillere, eller mobs/spillere angriper deg så faller du ned som en murstein.  Minigames, om det er over 7 spillere på serveren så kan det dukke opp tilfeldige minigames i chatten. For å joine skriver du bare /revent join i chatten, blir med på minigamet og da spillet er ferdig så kommer du tilbake akkurat der du var før spillet starta.  Om du er en som liker å bygge, eller ser etter en server å spille med venner så er dette serveren for deg.  Historie:  Dincraft har en lang historie. Dincraft starta opp i begynnelsen av 2014 og holdt på til midten av 2016. I midten av 2016 gikk Dincraft sammen med Ragefox for å skape Dinfox. Der samarbeidet serverne til Dincraft splitta fra Ragefox, og åpnet Dincraft igjen en liten periode før serveren ble nedlagt. I November 2018 så åpnet Dalskap Dincraft

description: Welcome, citizen. OrderSMP is a free survival server run by the Order: a calm, slightly too organized administration that keeps a record of everything. It counts chickens, inspects dirt houses and approves haircuts. Mostly it watches four factions fight over one world, in Sector Survival, the gamemode we built for this server.  The world is split into four quarters, with the Order city in the middle:  • Accord talks first and keeps every deal.  • Crescent wins with money and trade.  • Grove farms, builds and helps its neighbours.  • Bastion builds walls and holds the front line.  Pick your side in the lobby, then go to work.  » Land that really changes hands  There are no land claims. Build, mine, farm and fight near your faction's border and your faction earns points there. When your side is strong enough next to a rival region of 64 by 64 blocks, a front opens and a 24-hour siege begins, ending in a last stand. Win it and the region turns your colour on the live map. You can help from your first day; no rank needed. Fronts and sieges run now; sector captures open at our official launch, announced in Discord.  » Ranked PvP and bounties  Win fights to climb from LT5 up to HT1. Beating a player of your rank or higher gives the most points. Much weaker players give little or nothing. Put coins on a rival's head with /bounty.  » A market run by players  Sell with /ah or /sell and post buy orders with /orders. Players set every price. Your trade is on record.  » Mayors and politics  Each faction has one mayor: the first citizen to take the empty seat at the hub. The mayor gives the orders. name: 🍁 Kuschlige Herbststimmung auf Blockstal 🍁 | mcMMO - Jobs - Quests - MyPet - uvm.
description: Blockstal ist eine kleine, gemütliche und familiäre Community. Wir gehen alle friedlich und freundlich miteinander um, sind auch eher ruhig und dennoch für Späße zu haben :) Für Java UND Bedrock-Spieler!  Bei uns gehts hauptsächlich ums Survival, allerdings nicht komplett Vanilla. Wir haben Plugins die zB ein "sethome" ermöglichen, damit man schneller an seine Homepunkte kommt oder per warps in die Farmwelten / verschiedene Stellen in der Oberwelt.  Zum Farmen gibts bei uns separate Farmwelten (Farm, Nether und End), damit die Bauwelt nicht so zerpflückt wird. Diese Welten werden regelmäßig jedes Quartal resetted, damit auch immer genug Rohstoffe zur Verfügung stehen. Zusätzlich haben wir sogar noch eine Creative-Welt, auf der man sich ein Grundstück mieten kann oder mal ein Bauevent stattfindet.  Zudem bieten wir einen Adminshop, bei dem die Spieler Items kaufen aber auch verkaufen können.  Die Spieler können aber auch ihren eigenen Shop erstellen, um ingame-Geld (Blockstaler) zu verdienen. Zusätzlich verdient man sich ingame Geld über das Jobs-Plugin, bei dem man bis zu 2 Jobs gleichzeitig haben kann. Man kann die Jobs aber auch variabel wechseln und verliert nicht alle Stats, sodass man stetig je Tätigkeit und Job noch gut Geld verdienen kann.  Bei uns kann man sich für ingame Geld die permanent-fly Permission kaufen, generell sind alle Ränge ohne Echtgeld erspielbar. Die Ränge bringen ihre eigenen, kleinen Vorteile mit sich (siehe YouTube-Video bzw. Webseite). Generell müsst ihr hier für nichts reales Geld ausgeben!
